away: QB Jalen Hurts OUT for season (blood clots, IR) — Tanner McKee starts.
CBs Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) & Jonathan Jones (ankle) missed early-week practice ahead of CeeDee Lamb & George Pickens.
RB Saquon Barkley leads ground attack (371 rush yds) despite nagging midseason bumps.
home: QB Dak Prescott (hand) full participant; cleared to start.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle), OL Tyler Booker (ankle), LB Jaishawn Barham (hip/groin), LB Dee Winters (knee) held out of Monday walkthrough.
S P.J. Locke (concussion) & WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle) returned to limited work.

tendencies: Among the highest rates in the NFL for Defensive Pass Interference (DPI) and Offensive Holding.
Tight enforcement on line-of-scrimmage alignment and false starts.
Drive-stalling holding calls historically tilt multi-year totals tighter unless DPI hands out free red-zone yards.
referee.tonightImpact: DPI-happy Adrian Hill is worst-case officiating for a banged-up Eagles secondary (Mitchell & Jones hurt) trying to trail CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens.

why: Vic Fangio's defense keeps Philadelphia competitive in low-margin grinders (just beat Pittsburgh 19-16).
Dallas already surrendered 584 yards to SF and stripped DC Christian Parker of play-calling in November (handing calls to Mike Pettine); Saquon Barkley can test Dallas' front.
Eagles +8.5 attracts sharp contrarian value if Dallas injuries at LB (Barham/Winters) and OL (Booker) soften the middle.
how: Feed Saquon Barkley behind Chris Kuper's OL to shorten the game and keep Tanner McKee out of 3rd-and-long.
Have Fangio disguise coverages against Dak Prescott and force a sun-glare or turnover swing for defensive points.
Avoid downfield grabbing penalties against Adrian Hill's DPI-heavy crew.

why: Massive QB disparity: Dak Prescott (5 TDs last week, 2,724 yds) vs. backup Tanner McKee.
CeeDee Lamb & George Pickens already helped Dallas beat Philly 38-21 on Oct 26, now facing an injured Eagles CB room under DPI-happy Adrian Hill.
Brandon Aubrey (65-yd career long) gives Dallas automatic 3 points anywhere past the Philly 47-yard line.
how: Attack Philly's compromised cornerbacks vertically early with Lamb and Pickens to draw chunk plays or Adrian Hill DPI flags.
Let Mike Pettine's defense stack the box against Saquon Barkley and dare Tanner McKee to beat man coverage.
Lean on Aubrey to cash every stalled midfield drive into long-range field goals.

away: Chiefs enter Thanksgiving relatively healthy following a 34-7 blowout over Arizona (standard short-week maintenance).

why: KC owns the NFL's 3rd-youngest roster (25.7 avg age vs. 26.2), built to stay fresher on short-week Thursday travel.
Eric Bieniemy's 2026 return + RB Coach DeMarco Murray + Kenneth Walker III gave KC an explosive rushing engine that stresses Jim Leonhard's lighter front.
Andy Reid + Steve Spagnuolo + Dave Toub hold massive prime-time situational experience over Buffalo's restructured 2026 staff.
how: Hammer Kenneth Walker III downhill early in 35°F drizzle to neutralize Highmark crowd volume and set up Mahomes play-action.
Let Steve Spagnuolo mix late-clock blitz looks to force Josh Allen out of rhythm.
Manage the 40-second clock crisply to dodge Alex Kemp's signature Delay of Game flags.

why: Josh Allen is playing MVP-caliber dual-threat football for a 9-1 squad chasing the AFC #1 seed tiebreaker at home.
Alex Kemp lets corners play physical downfield (lenient illegal contact), helping Buffalo's secondary challenge KC receivers.
Orchard Park crowd noise + cold rain boosts Buffalo's home operational edge if Benford and Kincaid suit up.
how: Front-seven discipline from Terrance Jamison & John Egorugwu to force KC into predictable 3rd-and-medium passing situations.
Use Josh Allen's designed runs and quick perimeter touches (if DJ Moore is full-go) to keep Spagnuolo's blitzes off balance.
Stay clean on play-clock operations under Joe Brady/Pete Carmichael Jr. to steal late-half field position.
